goal: Refund veya chargeback durumunu invoice kaydını silmeden mali inceleme gerektiren güvenli bir sözleşmeye almak
rollback: Bu paketin state contract ve testini geri al; payment, invoice, document veya delivery verisini silme veya resetleme
acceptance: Refund and chargeback are review-required outcomes, never invoice deletion
Credit note or cancellation is not claimed without an explicit accounting decision
Invoice document remains private and delivery is not re-enqueued by the state contract
Unknown or contradictory payment states fail closed
